ctx.x: Clarinetist Joe Muranyi was born in Martin’s Ferry, Ohio on January 14, 1928.
He has worked as a record producer for major labels and played alongside Roy Eldridge, Jimmy McPartland and Max Kaminsky. Joe was a member of the Louis Armstrong All-Stars from 1967-1971.
Joe was interviewed in New York City on January 11, 2007 by Monk Rowe, director of the Hamilton College Jazz Archive. Tim Hicks and Vince Giordano participated briefly in the interview.
